title: [Pre Order] Free 3 Years Scheduled Servicing & $2000 Bunnings Gift Card with Chery Stockman PHEV (from $52,990 + ORC) @ Chery
body:

[shxhshzhz] A brand new ute model has no relation to gaskets from a Chery that was sold 15 years ago or a recall that affects axles in an Omoda SUV model
[MetalPhreak] And Toyota had brakes that failed, GM had defective key barrels that engaged the steering lock while driving . Ferrari's regularly catch fire. Porsche recalled Carrera GTs for months for suspension issues. Ford recalled F-150s this year because the fuel lines could come loose and catch fire. Name a car brand and there'll be some recent safety recall.
[plmko] The difference is Chinese companies stay mumm until the events force them to recall, it is not the same as many recalls that are pre-emptive

Ford eventually fixed it and there weren’t any more major incidents, but the stigma never, ever went away.
[tonyjzx] people who bring up asbestos in exhaust gasket is a special sort of retarded
the gaskets are sandwiched in between the exhaust flange points… you will not be breathing this in… have you ever even SEEN an exhaust been taken apart, is it even your job?
i work in property management and many many many houses still use an asbestos backed fuse box panel… the recommendation is NOT to change it if its intact
idiots worry about exhaust gaskets on cars that arent even on the roads any more and yet they dont know about this kind of thing
[plmko] You would have to be snorting some sort of special crayons to be comparing houses built 50-70years ago on cars built during an enlightened period where you know the effects of asbestos as if that's even in the same ball park.
[Jerome87] Chery confirmed the towing figures as non-negotiable for Australia. 3,495kg braked, not aspirational, not a stretch target. The baseline.
Looks like Claude wrote the whole site

not as if you can use copilot
[willyroo] 3,495kg isn't 3,500kg. So if your caravan is 3,500kg ATM, you might want to check the legalities.
(In Qld you can tow a trailer with higher ATM than your tug's rating - so long as it's at or under said rating)
[GordonD] It was a decision that looks strange to set the maximum towing weight at 3495 kg rather than a round 3500kg.
It has resulted in comments that it is "less" than the 3500 kg of other similar vehicles, when 5 kgs is so small a difference it isn't even noticeable, let alone significant.
It can't be genuinely engineering-based. How hard is it to upgrade whatever limits it to 3495 rather than 3500. Its not as if Toyota didn't just do a very minor upgrade to move the numbers on the Landcruiser so it could get away with dodging a required safety upgrade.
